{{Quote|Task Force Nova. A joint military and civilian effort to help the Jedi rebuild their order.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]]|<ref name="Objective Meridian" />}}
'''Task Force Nova''' was a joint military-civilian initiative founded by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] in [[3627 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> tasked with rebuilding the fragmented [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Objective Meridian" /><ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Task Force Nova}}</ref>

==Background==
In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="4.0 date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> the [[Eternal Empire]] under the direction of the former [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], now [[Valkorion]], led a series of [[Eternal Empire raids|raids]] into territories held by both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Following Valkorion's [[Assassination of Valkorion|assassination]], his son [[Arcann]] led a [[Eternal Empire conquest|brutal conquest]] across the [[Galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]], severely fragmenting both factions while increasing the strength of his empire.

As a result of the Eternal Empire's sudden emergence from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], both the Jedi Order and the Sith attempted to strike back at Arcann's forces, but sustained heavy losses in the process. Members of the Jedi scattered with some silently striking back or gathering strength (such as on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]) and others, such as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], going into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].

==The initiative==
{{Quote|Task Force Nova... an impressive undertaking. I'm surprised it took the Republic this long to prioritize the revitalization of the Jedi.|[[Lana Beniko]]|<ref name="Objective Meridian" />}}
The joint initiative was designed to rebuild the Jedi Order, which was heavily fragmented during the [[War against Zakuul|conflict]] with the Eternal Empire of [[Zakuul]] in the previous years. This venture was specifically tasked with locating and gathering the remaining Jedi due to the consensus that the Jedi were needed in order to take the fight to the Sith Empire in the newly waged [[third Galactic War]]. Jedi Master Gnost-Dural also conceived of the idea to re-establish the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], himself a surviving member.<ref name="Objective Meridian" /><ref name="Codex" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
[[File:Gnost-Dural_and_Daeruun.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Master Gnost-Dural and General Daeruun at the formation of the Task Force Nova]]
Supreme Chancellor Galena Rans offered the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]]&mdash;leader of the [[Eternal Alliance]]&mdash;the opportunity to join the joint initiative, with a guarantee that the Eternal Alliance would join the Galactic Republic with [[Odessen]] as its member world and its own [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. Rans also informed the Commander that its members, irrespective of their original faction in previous conflicts, would be given clean records and citizenship. General Daeruun would be chosen as the liaison to the Eternal Alliance in the new collaboration so that both sides could freely exchange intelligence and military reinforcements whenever and wherever required.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', Task Force Nova is established and gains its own codex entry. This new reform is jointly announced by Supreme Chancellor Galena Rans, General Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun, and Gnost-Dural to players who are progressing through the Republic's storyline. Depending on the player's class and gameplay choices, they may be asked to join this new task force.

*If the player is a '''Jedi Knight''', they will be restored as a member of the Jedi Order and named the official leader of the task force, reclaiming their position as the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Battlemaster]] while also being appointed as a new member in the rebuilt Jedi High Council.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is a '''Jedi Consular''', they will reclaim their title as the Master of Hidden Knowledge in addition to their seat on the Jedi High Council.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is a '''Republic Trooper''', they will be reinstated into the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], in control of the task force's military aspects, and will also be given the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]], which they had originally been granted "posthumously" when they disappeared during the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Zakuulan invasion]].<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
*If the player is a '''Smuggler''', they will be a "citizen privateer" with the effective rank of [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]], in control of the task force's civilian logistics.<ref name="Objective Meridian" />

Alternatively, through the Empire's storyline, saboteur players can learn of Task Force Nova's existence through [[Jonas Balkar]], who introduces the player to Master [[Sal-Deron]].<ref name="Objective Meridian" />
